posts.content_md:
I have a box of AGFA 8E75 paper that I received as part of the final sellout auction that they had when they sold it all off years ago. It must be 8 - 10 years old now. It has been kept in original packaging and stored appropriatly.

I havn't done any experimenting with Holography since I received this box so I don't know if the paper is even any good.

Is there anyone willing to test out a sheet for me just to find out if it's any good before I start messing around with it again? 

I can send a full sheet, you cut off enough to test with and use the rest for your own purposes. I would rather not wait a long time for the results so someone that is ready to test now would be appreciated.

Thanks

Jon

posts.author: HoloM
posts.content_md: Should be no problem, I think a few of us still have some 8e75 on stock and use it. I also use from time to time some AGFA. I had no sheet, which didn't work, but some sheets make only a weak or dim image.
